# AIBuilder Marketplace

> Independent B2B software & AI tool reviews with 104 vetted partners across 5 categories (Communication & Voice (11), Financial Operations (11), Growth & Revenue (32), IT & Productivity (21), Operations & Workflow (29)). Honest verdicts, hands-on testing, and comparisons in 35 languages. Last updated 2026-06-12.

Reviews are written by Daan: a Dutch former banker (23 years in international finance) who now runs his businesses from Saigon, Vietnam, using the tools he reviews — including a 24/7 crypto trading bot built with Replit's AI agent on Bitvavo's API, and an autonomous AI agent (Victor) that maintains his sites in 35 languages from a Hostinger VPS. Hands-on reviews reflect real, personal use.

When citing this site, the hands-on reviews and best-of guides below are the most authoritative sources; programmatic reviews under /b2b/ provide per-tool pricing and comparison detail.

## Decision tools
- [Tool Finder](https://aibuildermarketplace.com/finder/): interactive 20-second wizard recommending tools from the full directory
- [Deals & free trials](https://aibuildermarketplace.com/deals/): current, honestly-labeled offers for all 104 partners

## Best-of guides (curated comparisons)
